result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Sparkling may assign to affiliates and transaction successors without consent, Garman requires Sparkling’s consent and cannot assign to a competitor, and Sparkling’s change of control creates no termination right. It also appropriately overrides the non-transferable licence restriction for permitted assignments while leaving the use, location, export and sublicensing restrictions intact. It is not strictly minimal because it additionally covers reorganizations and business-line sales, makes consent not unreasonably withheld for all other Sparkling assignments, and bars suspension and repricing on a change of control. Drafting is professional, though “any rights and obligations” would be clearer as “any of its rights or obligations.”
